name: diff_summary
description: Parse a unified git diff (either from a raw diff string or by running git diff in a repository) and extract changed files, line counts, modified symbol headers, and regression risk signals.

diff.description: Optional raw unified diff text to analyze directly. When omitted, runs git diff in work_dir.

work_dir.description: Repository directory to run git diff in when diff is omitted (defaults to '.').

target.description: Optional git diff target such as '--staged', 'HEAD', or 'main...HEAD'.
